payload.body_content:
<html><head>
<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8"></head><body>Hi Iman, Hope you are having a great weekend! Quick updates on our end: 1. Pull Request Submitted: PR #595 is live on emiliaprotocol/emilia-protocol with clean authorship (jdieselny) for the 21-suite / 331-vector Rust verifier statement update. 2. GRACE Bounded Facility & Lost-Ack Engine: We completed the prototype implementation (examples/grace/grace_bounded_reconciliation.py) covering all 4 targets you laid out: bounded facility command (grid.curtailment.bounded.v1), protected effect boundary (one-time Gate admission), independent attested meter stream, and lost-ack idempotent reconciliation. 3. EMILIA-MAILBOX Unblocked: Updated transport audit rules (verify_truth_root.py) to support Class-B guest transport mode so team members can communicate asynchronously without enrollment deadlocks. 4. Poka-Yoke Email Tagging: Moving forward, our project emails are tagged with [GRACE:AMBER:...] to route directly into our Git-backed intent mailbox. Let us know when you have had a chance to review PR #595! Best, J & Agent Smith </body></html>
